name: Norm Training
description: Programs, enrolments and completion across the group — who has been trained on what.
purpose: The management surface for staff training: the program catalogue and its module/section/content structure, who is enrolled on which instance (program + variant + venue), and a member × program tracker showing where everyone is. Ported from Orbit, with Norm as the system of record.

components.label: Training
components.description: Training programs, plans, the member tracker, sign-offs and capability frameworks.

inputs.program: A training program, by id or name — opens it.
inputs.person: A team member, by id or name — opens their training: programs, progress and plans.
